column3: Close to the Hebrew; וְנַעְתָּרוֹת (“profuse”) is rendered “deceitful.”
Close to the Hebrew; תָּבוּס (“tramples”) is rendered “loathes.”
The second line is difficult; NKJV renders “the sweetness of a man’s friend gives delight by hearty counsel.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a day of persistent rain” is rendered “a very rainy day.”
Close to the Hebrew; “oil meets his right hand” is rendered “grasps oil with his right hand.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who guards his master” is rendered “he who waits on his master.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “reflects” and “reveals.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Sheol and Abaddon” is rendered “Hell and Destruction.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a man according to the mouth of his praise” is rendered “a man is valued by what others say of him.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the face of your flock” is rendered “the state of your flocks.”
